svg.aria-label: State diagram: Robot 1 + CNC (Setup 2, dual gripper A / B)
svg.text: State diagram: Robot 1 + CNC (Setup 2, dual gripper A / B)
Gripper A carries the raw part, gripper B the finished part. The raw part is picked while the CNC is still machining.

g.text: Home robot · check CNC ready and
Raw part in gripper A, gripper B empty ·
wait at the door while the CNC finishes
Empty gripper B grips the handle, slides
B takes the finished part out of the vise ·
wrist turns 180° · A places the raw part
Empty gripper A slides the door closed,
releases the handle · guard lock engages
Send CYCLE START (not during a quality
hold or a due tool change) · tool count + 1
Wait for ENC-43 = 0 and CP-2 entry clear
CNC alarm: HMI "Reset at the CNC panel"
amber light · robot waits at the door
Tool life reached: HMI "Change the tool"
amber light · robot waits at the door
From any state: timeout, a missing

svg.text: F FAULT and H HOLD can be entered from any state. FAULT = a confirmation is missing, a timeout
expired (the alarm names the sensor, no automatic robot retries) or an E-stop. HOLD = LINE STOP from the
cross-check supervisor: the robot finishes the running step, parks, and continues from there after the reset.

text.tspan: Robot home · CNC ready · ZS-32 door closed = ON
ZS-31 door open = ON · ZS-32 = OFF
GR-21A gripper A open · R1 clear of CNC
ZS-32 door closed = ON · ZS-33 locked
or CNC cycle complete (M30) · spindle stopped
No: first cycle, B is empty
